description: Use for 'Apply to Keywordise job abcde23456' or when the person asks to apply to a job from keywordise.com/jobs. Finds that job, puts it into the person's matches and starts the same application as the Apply button for that ONE job: tailors the CV and cover letter, answers the employer's questions and SUBMITS in the person's name. Needs the saved CV, a confirmed email and an active plan, and counts against the plan. Show the job first (get_public_job) and confirm with the person. dry_run=true prepares everything and sends nothing. Poll get_apply_run_status.

public_id.description: The Keywordise job id: ten letters and digits, the last part of a keywordise.com/jobs address (for example abcde23456).

name: apply_to_public_job
title: Apply to a job by its Keywordise id
